highlights_headline: Upcoming Skia m159 fixes harden mask-filtered glyph rendering and Imagination Vulkan allocation failure handling.

bullets.lead: Mask-filtered glyphs handle changing scaler output
bullets.detail: Uses the reloaded glyph's path when successive font-scaler loads disagree. Incompatible masks are cleared instead of copied, and clipped embossed masks retain full plane strides, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted mask planes.

bullets.lead: Imagination Vulkan allocation failures avoid unsafe cleanup
bullets.detail: Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after host or device out-of-memory allocation errors on Imagination drivers, where destroying the pool can trigger a driver failure. Graphite also prevents further allocation through the abandoned handle.
